name: backport_stop_reason
description: Values of `backport_stop_reason` in backport-report.schema.json. Why an Amalgamator backport run stopped before producing a backport on a branch; the pipeline mechanics that used to share the status vocabulary.

definitions.pipeline_stop: The Amalgamator pipeline halted at a gate before the commit phase.
definitions.pipeline_escalation: The pipeline escalated for human input and did not continue.
definitions.worktree_error: Preparing, preserving, or cleaning the git worktree failed.
definitions.timeout: The run exceeded its time budget for this branch.
definitions.error: An unclassified error stopped the run; `branch_result.error` carries the message.
